post_phase_remediations.triggered_by: human review after Phase 1 completed; user requested template + spec + audit-trail quality assessment
post_phase_remediations.what: Spec §7 ID-derivation rule (long-form ISSUE-* → short-form REGISTER/ANALYSIS/PROPOSAL)
post_phase_remediations.rationale: Spec §7 chose the long-form interpretation of ADR-0050 §Decision §7's ambiguous `<UPPERCASE-DOCTYPE>` phrasing (`ISSUE-ANALYSIS-foo`). All 3 sibling templates (T1.1/T1.2/T1.3) and all 5 empirical precedents use the short form (`ANALYSIS-foo`). Spec was the outlier. Load-bearing: Phase 2 T2.1 populates validator constants from the spec; if validator follows long form, it would reject every existing Issues/* file post-migration. Phase 3 migrations also preserve short-form IDs. Fix: §7 rewritten to use short form with explicit `strip the issue- prefix and uppercase` rule + load-bearing-for-migration callout + rationale subsection.
post_phase_remediations.diff_summary: §7 section rewritten (~20 lines): prefix table changed from `ISSUE-REGISTER/ANALYSIS/PROPOSAL` to `REGISTER/ANALYSIS/PROPOSAL`; 3 examples updated; rationale subsection added explaining the strip-prefix interpretation.
post_phase_remediations.discovered_by: human post-phase quality review (not caught by Phase 1 per-task or phase-quality validators because PV-1 checks the §4 table byte-match but does not cross-verify §7 against templates + precedents)
post_phase_remediations.pv1_gap_observation: PV-1 validator set has no cross-file consistency check between templates and spec. Recommend adding a future invariant: spec §7 examples MUST follow the same prefix convention as the 3 template `id:` placeholders. Out-of-scope for this run; surface as Issue (issue-analysis) via /capture-issue once Phase 4 ships.

post_phase_remediations.what: Spec frontmatter polish: doc_type `reference-spec` → `spec`; status `Proposed` → `complete`; version 1.0.0 → 1.0.1
post_phase_remediations.rationale: doc_type `reference-spec` was producer-invented and not a validator-recognized category. Switched to `spec` (cleaner, equally outside validator scope) with explicit comment in frontmatter noting the spec lives under .claude/skills/ which is outside validator scan scope. status `Proposed` used ADR-state vocabulary (Proposed→Accepted) wrong for a non-ADR; switched to `complete` (analysis-category terminal state, matches post-Phase-1 quality-review-passed reality). Version bumped to 1.0.1 per ADR-0005 supersession discipline (post-PASS minor revision).
